semantics.ordering: causal DAG; server_sequence is a pull cursor, not causal order
semantics.signing: AC-EVENT-1 Ed25519 portable signing; legacy Go encoding accepted
semantics.resume: portable rehydrate; native resume requires adapter detection
semantics.billing: accepted-event/1: event and api.mutation usage commit atomically; duplicates add zero; task owner or organization is payer
semantics.audit: signed events preserve device provenance; HTTP audit/webhook enqueue are currently best-effort
semantics.distributed_transactions: PostgreSQL transactional outbox + JetStream at-least-once + idempotent worker; no cross-cloud XA
semantics.currency: integer minor units; CNY/USD/EUR; provider fees and model token bills are separate
semantics.extensions: preserve unknown namespaced extensions; negotiate capability intersection before use
